content: Jon baptais kwiydidi duw maaj wasapwiydil Jisasak.
Ki viyakita maaj Jisas Kraisak, God dikidi Nyanad. Taay ki viyakita maaj atawa wakwul.
Tayir God diki maaj wasapwiydi duw, dikidi si Aysaya, ki God dikidi Nyinik wadil maaj di sukwudil. God wanaad,

content.text: Yin niki jaav niki jaav minak kwulapwu-kinaad.
Duw nak tamiyaka tamiyaam gaam sinaad, ‘Niki jaav niki jaav kwulapwun ada nimadi sapakwa duwak.

content: Alik duw nak, dikidi si Jon, tamiyaka tamiyaam warkuw, duw takwak baptais kwiydidiy. Dayak ki maaj kwiydidiy, “Gwuradiy mawul awarapiy. Warapiygwur, baptais kwatiya-kituwadiygwur. God gwuradiy vaal ata yibwiy-kidadiy.”
Samasama Juwtiya tamiya kidiy duw takwawa Jiruwsalim tipa kidiy duw taakw wakwudiy Jon diki maaj wukik. Aw day dayadiy vaal wasapwiykuw, Jon ata baptais kwiydidiy Jawtan bayibim.
Jon dikidi wapwiy kamil yuwiyir vildaad. Sipapuwtuwawa jitakadid. Di kwarbag kitika jaav si lakis wawa kwudiyugw daya guwawa kad.
Jon diki maaj, “Duw nak wuna kwukir yakinaad. Mwiya sapakwa duw, yitaypika duw-ad. Wun yisadapik tinadiwun. Wun kidi duw dikidiy jaav yatayat maa rav.
“Guwaam baptais bwu kwatiya-tuwadiygwur. Aw di God dikidi Mawulaam baptais kwiy-kidadiygwur.”
Jon baptais kwiydid Jisasak.
A nyi Jisas Galiliyaam ridi tip Nasaritaam alim kwakuw, Jonak ata yaad. Jisas yadik, Jon baptais kwiydid Jawtan bayibim.
Kwiyin napadik, Jisas guwaam tikuw, ata warid. Wardik, vidik, jayib ni God nyamaliygaay kajatakadid. Nyamaliygaay kajatakakuw, God dikidi Mawul ata daad midakim kitik Jisasak.
Jisas ata ki God wadil maaj wukidil, “Min wuna mawul yinadi Nyan-adimin. Wun rakarak tinadiwun minak.”
Satan Jisasak wasupwudid.
Jayib ni adi Mawul mwugiydik, Jisas kipa tamiyaar ata yad.

Yikuw, nyi duwamiy vitiy alim kwadidiy. Nyanyi Satan Jisasak wasupwun vasibariyik ata kwurdid. Sapiy tidiy jaav kupwaam tiytiyaan tidiy adi tamiyaam. God dikidiy maaj kardadiy duw Jisasak sugwiyaan kwurdiy.
Jisas bas kwurdil diki yawiy Galiliy tamiyaam.
Day Jonaam kalabus ir yakisawulakuw, Jisas ata Galiliyaar yad. Yikuw, di God diki viyakita maaj duw takwak wadidiy.
Di dayak waad, “Nyi akaanaka. God diki duw takwak van tikida nyi walibab tina. Vaal yigwuradiy mawul wapakuw, ki viyakita majib wukijibir ada.”
Jisas di duw aliyak gaam sididiy.
Jisas ar si Galiliy, di mala arasaay yaad. Yakuw, Sayman-awa dikidi nyamwus Adiruw Jisas vidibir. Bir nagir yakisakwubir guwaar kamiy kwurik. Aal biraki yawiy-al.
Jisas ata wadibir, “Bir wuna kwukib may! Yakuw, wun kalivaaw. Bir duw kwurkinabirbir tayir kamiy kwurbiril pik.”
Jayib ni nagir wapakuw, Jisas diki kwukib yibir.
Jisas kwasa yikuw, ata vidibir Sipatiy dikibir nyidiy, Jamis-awa Jon. Bir biraki jabiraam kwabir biradiy nagir tap tipa-biridiy.
Jisas birakik wataydik, biradi asaay Sipatiyawa jabiraam kwadiy duwawa wapakuw, Jisas diki kwukib ata yibir.
Jisas duw nak diki mawulaar yidi wudib kwurin yakidid.
Day tip si Kapanamaar wuladiy. Juw daya yaap kwadadiy nyi, si Sapat, wuladik, Jisas Juw daya gaba maja wiyaar ata wulaad. Wulakuw, ata kalivadidiy.
Day diki maaj wukikuw, pitaan wardiy. Agwak, di kalivadidiy lo kalivadiy duw kitik maa. Di niki maaj niki maaj lakwudi duw-ad.

Duw nak gaba maja wiyaar ata wulaad. Adi duw tayir diki mawulaar wudib yidid. Di Jisasak nimadib gaam sidid, “Jisas Nasarit tipa kid, min agwa jaav kwurik nyanaam? Min nyanaam viyapakwuk? Wun bwutaay lakwu-tuwadimin. Min God dikidi nikidi kapaba duw-adimin!”
Jisas nimadib adi wudibak ata wadid, “Kaygan ada! Min kidi duwaam ata awap!”
Adi wudib mwugiydik, adi duw kupwaam vakirbagwun, gaam sibagwun, ata kwurkuw, adi wudib ata wapadid.
Ababa duw taakw ata pitaan wardiy ata walas kirasin ran bwuladiy, “Kal agwa jaava? Kwula jaav nyanak kalivada? Adiy wudib diki majib wukinadiy. Di ap tinadi duw-ad.”
Galiliyaam rikuw, ababa duw taakw jayib ni wukidaal Jisas kwurdidiy jaav.
Jisas Pita diki nakim liki giviyib sipwutiydil.
Jisas Juw daya gaba maja wiy wapadik, Saymanawa Adiruw biraki wiyaar yad. Jamisawa Jon diwa yibir.
Sayman diki nakim sip kuwkuw nalilik, alik jabim ral. Yabiyib Jisasak wadaad likik.
Di wakwukuw, tabaam kaykitikuw, kirapitakadik, kuwkuw nal sip yabiyib nikir tayil. Li ata dayak kikipaat sukwulik yal.
Jisas samasama giviyib kwurdiy duw taakw sipwutiydidiy.
Giraab nyi dadik, samasama duw taakw nuwukadiy giviyib kwurdiy, nuwukadiy wudib mawulaar yidadiy, duw taakw Jisasak kwurin kariyadadiy.
Adi tipa kidiy duw taakw abab wiya tipigwusim vagaluwdiy.

Samasam niki giviyib niki giviyib kwurdiy duw taakw Jisas sipwutiydidiy. Nuwukadiy duw taakw wudib mawulaar yidadiy, Jisas adiy wudibak, “Gwur agwutak!” wadik, tabwudiy. Adiy wudib Jisas bwu vidaad. Alik Jisas watipididiy, “Maaj bwulaway!” wakuw.
Jisas maaj wasapwiydil Galiliy wadaal tamiyaam.
Sira pik ganib gitigit nalik, Jisas di ata rapid. Rapikuw, wiy wapakuw, kipa tamiyaar ata yad. Yikuw, di Godak maaj bwulaad.
Sayman diwa kwadiy duwawa kwakiyin kwakiyaan tamiyaka tamiyaam ata tidiy.
Tikuw, ata vidaad Jisasaam. Vikuw, ata wadaad, “Nyan abab minak kwakibagwu-nadiyan.”
Jisas dayak ata waad, “Nyan aka niki tip niki tipaam tiytiyaan tikidiyan. Wun dayak ab God diki maaj wakir. Ki yawiyik wakwudiwun.”
Galiliy wadidi tamiyaar yad. Yikuw, niki tip niki tipaar yin yaan tad. Dayadiy gaba maja wiyaar wulakuw, God diki maaj kwiydidiy. Di duw mawulaar yidiy wudib kwurin yakididiy.
Jisas lepa giviyib kwurdi duw sipwutiydid.
Lepa duw nak yakuw, Jisasak kwatiyir sikuw, nimadib bas sidid, “Mina mawul warlik, wuna sip sipwutiy-kimina.”
Jisas dikik wukikuw, taab ata dikim takakuw, ata wadid, “Wun minak sipwutiyik viyakit timinkikik.”
Ata wadik, yabiyib lepa giviyib wapalik, diki sip viyakita mwiy tal.
Jisas dikik wayakik tikuw, aw taay nimadib wadid.
Di wadid, “Min awuk! Kipa duw takwak wawayik. Yabiyib maay pris ak mina sip vidikikik. Tayir Mawsis wadidiygwur jaav akwiy Godak. Alik ababa duw taakw wukikwadiy mina giviyib aka bwu kwusina.”

Adi duw Jisasaam wapakuw, yad. Yikuw, kipa duw takwak wadidiy Jisas diki lepa giviyib sipwutiydil. Samasam wadidiy a javik, alik Jisas niki tip niki tipaar yiyi maa rav. Kipa tamiyaam kwaad, Jisas. Niki tip niki tipa duw taakw yaan vagaluwdiy dikik.
